description.value: Red Barn Market began as a farm stand at this West Saanich location in 2002 and has grown into a locally owned chain of eight stores across Greater Victoria. The market emphasises Island Grown, Island Raised, and Island Made products, including its own on-site Smokehouse producing small-batch bacon, sausages, and deli meats. The West Saanich store also houses a Sandwich Bar and a Pet Food & Feed Market, making it a notably well-stocked stop on the rural West Saanich Road corridor.
